units.source_text: 这一年三条宫邸遭了火灾，尼僧三公主迁居六条院。

en.t: That year, the Sanjo palace residence was damaged by fire, and the nun Third Princess moved to Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 薰君为此奔走忙碌，许久不赴宇治访问。

en.t: Lord Kaoru was busy rushing about because of this, and for a long time he did not go to Uji to visit.

units.source_text: 谨严之人的心情，自与普通人不同，最能忍耐持久。

en.t: The feelings of a strictly upright person naturally differ from those of ordinary people, and such a person can endure the longest.

units.source_text: 他虽然心中已经认定大女公子早晚是自己的人了，

en.t: Although in his heart he had already decided that the elder young lady would sooner or later be his,

units.source_text: 但在女方尚未表示心许的期间，决不做轻率唐突的行为。

en.t: he would never act rashly or intrusively while she had not yet shown that she accepted him.

units.source_text: 他只管确守八亲王的遗嘱而竭诚照顾，

en.t: He simply held firmly to Prince Hachi's last wishes and cared for her with all his heart,

units.source_text: 希望女公子理解他的诚心。

en.t: hoping that the young lady would understand his sincerity.
